SUI-EUR.summary: A scheduled SUI supply release appears to have occurred on October 3, 2026, immediately before this October 4 snapshot. This creates current dilution/flow risk even though no fresh protocol exploit or confirmed network outage was identified.
materialRisks: Recent scheduled SUI unlock/release on October 3, 2026; third-party schedule data estimates the event at roughly 22.6M SUI, creating near-term supply-overhang risk.
SUI’s official tokenomics state that additional tokens are released periodically and that release timing/deployment can be adjusted by the Sui Foundation.
